depiction_rules.notes: One recurring mature cowherd chief and father. Keep him distinct from Garga Muni (elderly ascetic with white beard and topknot) and Vasudeva (longer dark hair and fuller beard).

visual_bible.face: gently rounded or oval face, dark moustache, calm protective expression
visual_bible.hair: dark hair gathered or covered simply
visual_bible.build: ordinary adult proportions with natural two-armed anatomy
visual_bible.clothing: simple cream dhoti with muted olive or green upper cloth or head covering
visual_bible.continuity_markers: same rounded face with dark moustache, cream dhoti and muted olive/green upper cloth or head covering in every scene

never: no royal crown or ornate court costume
no changing face or cream-and-olive clothing vocabulary between scenes
